sections.name: observeAssembly
sections.title: Scene data recorder
sections.what: Walks the 3D scene, records each named part's position, rotation, world matrix, shape type, visibility, colour and bounds, and stores them on the canvas.
sections.why: Stated in the code comment: it is only injected for the regression server.
sections.watch_out: A part is hidden if any parent is hidden, so the visibility value covers the whole chain.

summary: A test helper that records each named part's position, size, colour and visibility into the canvas so that a regression test can read them.
purpose: Lets the regression test check what was drawn without looking at pixels.
why: Stated in the code comment: it is injected only by the regression server and never imported by production code.
how: Updates the scene's world positions, walks every mesh with a part ID, collects its data, and writes the result as text into a data attribute on the canvas.
inputs: A three.js scene and the canvas element.
outputs: A JSON string in the canvas data attribute named testAssembly.
risks: Only meshes that have a string part ID and a buffer geometry are recorded. Parts without those are silently skipped.
debug: If the regression test sees missing parts, check that the mesh has a part ID and a buffer geometry.
